full_judgment: 5. The opposite. party Nos. 1, 5, and 6 appeared in the said title suit on 10-6-1981, filed a joint written statement on the allegation, inter alia, that the suit was not maintainable and that suit was bad for defect of parties and the suit was barred by res judicata and the suit property was under-valued, the plaint was insufficiently stamped and the suit was barred by limitation and was not maintainable for want of cause of action. The opposite party Nos.9-16 were the legal owners and accordingly, for non-payment of Government rent the "ka" scheduled certificate cases were started and the same were legally and lawfully purchased by opposite party Nos.1-8. The story of the settlement of the petitioner was false. The petitioner at the time of alleged settlement was not a citizen of Pakistan and the father of the petitioner on 3-2-53 for the first time entered into Pakistan and that at the time of the alleged pattan the plaintiff was a boy of 2/3 years only and therefore the suit of the plaintiff-petitioner was liable to be dismissed.
